findings.evidence: The `group` marker was removed from both Card roots (MantineListingCardPattern.tsx:163, :290) without a cross-file consumer census. VARIANTS.listing.hoverClass = 'group-hover:scale-105' (src/components/ui/appImageConfig.ts:66) is applied unconditionally at AppImage.tsx:151 and enters this pattern through the `image` slot from ListingCard.tsx:243. Neither ListingCard <Link> carries `group` (:201-206 horizontal, :296-302 vertical) and no other ancestor supplies it. The utility is still emitted — .next/static/css/3b5759d2e996cb5d.css contains `.group-hover\:scale-105:is(:where(.group):hover *){...scale:var(--tw-scale-x) var(--tw-scale-y)}` — so it now matches nothing on the vertical card. The CSS `scale` property is independent of the module's surviving `transform: scale(1.05)` on .card:hover .imageSection img, so the composite hover zoom changes; D28 permits zero visual delta. The list layout is unaffected because listing-thumb declares no hoverClass. docs/critical-flow-registry.md:57 names 'image scale(1.05)' as governed behaviour, so clause 15 requires automated regression evidence. Required correction: restore the marker or re-anchor the consumer, then measure the composite scale and transform before and after on the vertical card.

The module's own header (:22-25) states the file's invariant is the opposite, and the new comment at :221-226 asserts a false fact about the compiler. docs/critical-flow-registry.md:57 names 'touch taps never get stuck-hovered' as governed behaviour. Correction scope: the exact baseline carries (hover: hover) alone, so adopting the file's two-condition (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) guard would itself be a fresh media delta requiring an owner decision — it does not discharge this finding by itself.
